raw.title: Strategic Content Editor (Contract-to-Hire)
raw.excerpt: The situation, honestlyOur content department head is going on a planned leave in the near future.
raw.description:
The situation, honestly

Our content department head is going on a planned leave in the near future. Before that happens, we need a senior editor in place who can hold the line on strategy and quality while she's out, then keep raising the bar when she's back.

This starts as a contract role with a clear path to a full-time hire based on performance. We're not being coy about it: the leave is the reason for the speed, and the contract period is a working trial on both sides. If you do well, there's a permanent senior seat here with a benefits package.

Because of that timeline, we need someone who can ramp fast and operate independently. You'll get a real onboarding, documented strategy, and a team that knows what it's doing. You will not get six months to find your footing.

Who we are

RGX is a digital marketing agency built for home service businesses: HVAC, pest control, plumbing, electrical, and the trades that keep homes running.

Our clients are not hobby businesses. They’re doing $1.5M+ in annual revenue, investing in growth.

We help serious service businesses get clearer about what they offer, sharper about who they serve, and more direct about why a customer should choose them. Strategy first. Every sentence accountable to the business it serves.

What you'll actually do

  • Review strategy before content exists. You'll read content briefs, keyword strategies, and funnel plans before writing starts, and pressure-test them. If the targeting is off, the search intent is misread, or the funnel logic doesn't hold, you catch it at the brief stage, not the draft stage.
  • Edit for strategic alignment. Every draft gets checked against the strategy it was written to serve. You'll verify the copy matches the persona, the CTA fits the funnel stage, and the content actually satisfies the search intent we're targeting.
  • Create editing standards where they don't exist. If you notice a recurring writing problem, a missing tone of voice guide, or a gap in our editorial process, you build the fix. You don't wait to be asked, and you don't file it as someone else's problem. You do pause long enough to get leadership and team buy-in, because a standard only works if the people using it helped shape it. Fix what's broken, and fix it with the team rather than around them.
  • Spot ranking opportunities the brief missed. You read SERPs, not just drafts. If a piece could capture a featured snippet with a structural change, or a related keyword cluster is sitting there unclaimed, you flag it and adjust.
  • Run quality control. You're the last set of eyes before content ships. Clarity, flow, tone, accuracy, brand voice, and the unglamorous stuff like internal links, metadata, and formatting. You'll help formalize our QA process so quality doesn't depend on any one person being in the room.
  • Give writers feedback that makes them better. Direct, specific, actionable notes that explain the strategic reasoning, not just the correction. Our writers are good. Your job is to make them sharper.

Requirements

Where this goes

This role exists because our content department is growing faster than one director can quality-control. The interim coverage is the immediate need. The real opportunity is what comes after.

The person who succeeds here will help build the editorial function itself: the standards, the QA program, the feedback systems that let a team scale without quality slipping. As the department grows, this seat is positioned to grow into a leadership role, including mentoring and eventually managing editors. You'll be learning team leadership directly from the content director, with real responsibility from week one rather than a title and a waiting period.

If you're a senior editor who has hit the ceiling at your current job, this is the next rung.

Who does well in this role

  • 5+ years editing strategic marketing content (SEO content, landing pages, email, PPC assets) in an agency or similar fast-moving environment. You've edited for performance outcomes, not just polish.
  • You can read an SEO strategy document and find its weak points. Keyword selection, intent mapping, funnel logic, content architecture. This is fluency, not familiarity.
  • You work independently by default. During the leave period, you'll be making editorial calls without a director to escalate to. You need the judgment to make those calls and the documentation habits to make them defensible.
  • You're a genuine team player. Independent doesn't mean lone wolf. You'll be collaborating daily with writers, strategists, and PMs, and your feedback style needs to build trust fast.
  • You're direct and kind in the same sentence. Writers should leave your edits better at their jobs, not deflated.
  • You want more responsibility than your current role gives you. You've probably already been doing unofficial leadership work: mentoring writers, building processes nobody asked for, being the person the team actually goes to. You want a seat where that's the job description instead of the extra credit.

Benefits

How the role works

  • Contract engagement to start, with conversion to full-time based on performance during the contract period.
  • Fully remote. We'll need meaningful overlap with US Eastern Time business hours for collaboration.
  • Competitive contract rate commensurate with experience ($3,000-$5,000 a month). Full-time conversion includes salary, benefits, PTO, and professional development budget.

raw.title: Senior Clinical Oncology Solutions Architect
raw.excerpt: Position SummaryAt Navista, our mission is to empower community oncology practices to deliver patient-centered cancer care.
raw.description:
Position Summary

At Navista, our mission is to empower community oncology practices to deliver patient-centered cancer care. Navista, a Cardinal Health company, is an oncology practice alliance co-created with oncologists and practice leaders that offers advanced support services and technology to help practices remain independent and thrive. True to our name, our experienced team is passionate about helping oncology practices navigate the future.

The Senior Clinical Oncology Solutions Architect is a senior individual contributor position responsible for designing, building, integrating, and supporting clinical application solutions used by oncology practices across the Navista Network. This role works closely with architects, product managers, clinicians, vendors, and fellow engineers to deliver secure, scalable, and interoperable healthcare systems, with a strong emphasis on hands‑on engineering and operational excellence.

This position is ideal for an experienced Senior Engineer with deep healthcare systems experience who enjoys working at the intersection of clinical workflows, technology, and real‑world operations in a multi‑practice Oncology MSO environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and support integrations across oncology clinical and business systems, including EHR/EMR, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), PACS, Laboratory Information Systems (LIS), and pharmacy platforms
  • Implement interoperable solutions using FHIR, HL7, REST APIs, and industry‑standard integration patterns
  • Collaborate with solution architects and product teams to translate clinical workflows into practical, scalable technical designs
  • Lead hands‑on development and configuration of interfaces, services, and integration workflows across clinical systems
  • Review code, integration logic, and technical designs to ensure reliability, performance, security, and maintainability
  • Troubleshoot complex application and integration issues across development, testing, and production environments
  • Contribute to the development and adoption of architectural standards, clinical data models, and integration best practices
  • Partner with vendors and internal teams during implementations, upgrades, and post‑go‑live optimization
  • Ensure solutions align with HIPAA, HITRUST, and patient privacy requirements
  • Provide peer mentorship and technical guidance to engineering team members
  • Clearly communicate technical concepts, risks, and tradeoffs to clinical, operational, and leadership stakeholders

Qualifications

  • 8-12 years of experience in software engineering, systems integration, or healthcare technology environments, preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in in Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field (or equivalent experience), preferred
  • 3+ years of direct experience working with clinical applications or healthcare platforms, preferred
  • Demonstrated hands‑on experience with EHR systems, healthcare integrations, and interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7)
  • Experience supporting oncology practices, cancer centers, or oncology‑focused healthcare platforms strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of clinical workflows and healthcare data exchange
  • Practical experience operating in regulated environments with HIPAA / HITRUST compliance
  • Experience designing, deploying, or supporting integration engines, workflow orchestration tools, or care coordination platforms
  • Exposure to AI‑enabled healthcare solutions or clinical decision support tools is a plus
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and the ability to work effectively across engineering, clinical, and business teams

What is expected of you and others at this level

  • Applies advanced knowledge and understanding of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to manage a wide variety of projects
  • Participates in the development of policies and procedures to achieve specific goals
  • Recommends new practices, processes, metrics, or models
  • Works on or may lead complex projects of large scope
  • Projects may have significant and long-term impact
  • Provides solutions which may set precedent
  • Independently determines method for completion of new projects
  • Receives guidance on overall project objectives
  • Acts as a mentor to less experienced colleagues

Anticipated salary range: $123,400 - $176,300

Bonus eligible: Yes

Benefits: Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well-being.

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Paid time off plan
  • Health savings account (HSA)
  • 401k savings plan
  • Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Work-Life resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Healthy lifestyle programs

Application window anticipated to close: 06/28/2026 *if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible.

The salary range listed is an estimate. Pay at Cardinal Health is determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographical location, relevant education, experience and skills and an evaluation of internal pay equity.

Candidates who are back-to-work, people with disabilities, without a college degree, and Veterans are encouraged to apply.

Cardinal Health supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate the power of our differences to create better solutions for our customers by ensuring employees can be their authentic selves each day. Cardinal Health is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.

As a member of the Software Defined Networking team, you will own and deliver the code to bring our network to the next level. As a "militantly automated" team, we work in Source Control and let pipelines drive our work. We believe in configuration modeling and defining standards via automation so the tooling can do the heavy lifting for us. You will participate on a high performing team that designs, builds, and runs world-class and leading-edge networking technology on many exciting platforms.

raw.description:
As a copy-editor or proofreader you'll ensure that material is clear, consistent, complete and credible, and that text is well written, grammatically correct and accessible.

You'll be required to correct spelling, grammar and layout (proofreading), check content, use consistent styles and reword or rewrite (copy-editing).

Responsibilities

  • correcting spelling mistakes and grammatical errors
  • sub-editing text written by a number of executive to ensure consistent style
  • working with IT-based publishing systems and databases, as well as via the internet or from paper manuscripts
  • liaising regularly with clients by phone and email
  • checking that clients have provided all the required materials and paperwork
  • creating artwork briefs to detail the content of illustrations
  • ensuring that illustrations are correctly captioned and referred to in the text
  • producing or working to a style checklist to ensure consistency in hyphenation, capitalisation, formatting of references, etc
  • maintaining awareness of new words or phrases coming into popular usage with a view to ensuring they're appropriate for the readership
  • discussing and resolving any potentially libelous sections
  • retrieving articles from archives and rearranging within publications
  • overseeing the work of indexers, typesetters and designers
  • typesetting and designing layout.

¿Qué reto proponemos?

Buscamos un Arquitecto de Plataforma para proyecto bancario, para diseñar y evolucionar la plataforma de ingeniería interna como producto que habilite a los equipos a entregar software e infraestructura de forma coordinada, autónoma, segura y eficiente, en un entorno híbrido que barca una estrategia multicloud, on-prem y Mainframe.

¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia consolidada en roles de arquitectura técnica, habitualmente a partir de 5 años en su dominio de especialización.
· Experiencia demostrada y profunda en al menos uno de los entornos del ecosistema corporativo: on-prem (VMware, Kubernetes on-prem) o cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP), con comprensión del modelo híbrido.
· Experiencia en el diseño e implantación de plataformas de desarrollo orientadas al autoservicio (Internal Developer Platform).
· Diseño de pipelines CI/CD con integración de controles de seguridad y calidad (SSDLC).
· Automatización del ciclo de vida de infraestructura mediante código (IaC) en entornos híbridos.
· Kubernetes y ecosistema de contenedores: despliegue, ciclo de vida, seguridad y networking.
· Diseño y documentación de arquitectura.
· Capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas técnicos complejos.
· Implicación directa en la fase de construcción: toma de decisiones técnicas en contexto real, resolución de problemas durante la implementación y responsabilidad sobre la coherencia entre el diseño y lo construido.
· Comunicación técnica clara con todos los equipos de tecnología.
· Comprensión del entorno regulatorio bancario en lo que aplica a su dominio.
· Orientación al producto interno: trata la plataforma como un producto con usuarios reales.
· Empatía con el equipo de desarrollo: diseña pensando en reducir fricción y carga cognitiva en el ciclo de entrega.
· Capacidad de crear abstracciones que oculten complejidad sin perder control.

¿Qué tenemos para ti?

  • Contrato indefinido y jornada completa
  • 23 días de vacaciones
  • Formación continua: competencias técnicas, transversales y de idiomas. Contamos con acceso a certificaciones, formaciones de los principales Partners Tecnológicos, plataformas online y ¡mucho más!

  • Onboarding personalizado y detallado. Te acompañamos en todo momento para que te sientas #soprano desde el primer momento.
  • Oficina con espacios reservados al ocio. ¡Trabajo y diversión unido!
  • Compañerismo y buen ambiente, el poder de la unión lo tenemos presente.

Y lo más importante…Tienes la posibilidad de desarrollar tu carrera profesional con nosotros: Crearemos juntos un plan de carrera personalizado. Te formarás, marcaremos objetivos y llevaremos a cabo un seguimiento para asegurarnos de que lo conseguimos juntos. Escuchamos tus prioridades y luchamos por ellas.

¡Aquí tu voz importa! ¡Únete a nosotros y sé parte de algo más!

The world is how we shape it

En Sopra Steria estamos comprometidos con la creación de un entorno diverso e inclusivo, evaluando cada candidatura de forma objetiva, en base a sus competencias y experiencia. Creemos firmemente que la diversidad de experiencias y perspectivas es lo que impulsa nuestra innovación.

raw.description:
2Modern is seeking a strategic Brand Merchandising Manager to lead the growth and performance of a portfolio of luxury home furnishings brands. Serving as the primary business owner for your brands, you'll drive merchandising strategy, business planning, and cross-functional execution to deliver exceptional customer experiences and profitable growth.

You'll build trusted vendor partnerships, shape assortments, identify growth opportunities, and ensure each brand is positioned for success across 2Modern's digital marketplace. Combining strong merchandising instincts with data-driven decision-making, you'll leverage performance insights, customer behavior, and market trends to influence strategy and drive results.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy and execution, enjoys collaborating across teams, and is passionate about building long-term partnerships with world-class design brands.

Brand Ownership & Partnership

  • Own the overall health, performance, and strategic direction of an assigned portfolio of luxury brands.
  • Build trusted relationships with vendor partners, serving as their primary business advisor and day-to-day point of contact.
  • Lead assortment planning, business reviews, promotional planning, pricing discussions, and long-term growth initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen partnerships through thoughtful business recommendations backed by data and market insights.
  • Ensure alignment with 2Modern's merchandising standards, operational requirements, and brand presentation expectations.
  • Merchandising Strategy & Assortment Management
  • Develop curated assortments that reflect customer demand, design leadership, and business performance.
  • Drive assortment optimization through SKU productivity analysis, whitespace identification, lifecycle management, and rationalization initiatives.
  • Evaluate opportunities for expansion, contraction, and new product introductions based on profitability, customer behavior, and market trends.
  • Partner with leadership on new brand launches, seasonal merchandising strategies, and category growth initiatives.
  • Monitor competitive positioning, pricing, and industry trends to maintain 2Modern's premium market position.

Business Performance & Analytics

  • Own brand performance through ongoing analysis of sales, gross profit, margin, return rates, customer experience, inventory considerations, and operational metrics.
  • Translate data into actionable recommendations that improve profitability and customer experience.
  • Identify risks, opportunities, and emerging trends, proactively developing strategies to accelerate growth or address underperformance.
  • Support forecasting, promotional planning, and business reviews with data-driven insights.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Partner closely with Marketing, Site Merchandising, Production, Operations, Trade, Customer Experience, and Leadership to ensure flawless execution across the customer journey.
  • Ensure products launch accurately, are merchandised effectively, and meet 2Modern's standards for content quality, imagery, navigation, and discoverability.
  • Coordinate promotional initiatives, assortment updates, pricing changes, and operational improvements across departments.
  • Help create alignment around merchandising priorities through clear communication and shared business objectives.

Requirements

You're a Great Fit If You Have

  • 5+ years of merchandising or category management experience within luxury home furnishings, lighting, furniture, or premium consumer brands.
  • A strong business mindset with experience managing assortment performance, profitability, and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Strong analytical skills and confidence using data to influence merchandising decisions.
  • Experience building collaborative vendor relationships while balancing brand needs with business objectives.
  • Outstanding organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.
  • A refined design sensibility and strong merchandising eye, paired with a disciplined, customer-first approach to assortment planning.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets; familiarity with Shopify and modern eCommerce merchandising platforms is preferred.

raw.description:
Position Overview

Blue Acorn iCi is looking for a Workfront Consultant to serve as a client-facing technical consultant focused on helping clients realize and quantify value from Adobe Workfront solutions. This role requires deep technical expertise in Adobe Workfront, Workfront Fusion, enterprise integrations, and project management methodologies, along with strong strategic and analytical skills.

The Workfront Consultant will work closely with clients to understand business objectives, assess technical environments, evaluate solution designs, and provide recommendations that drive customer success and business impact. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor, helping organizations maximize their investment in Adobe Workfront through architecture guidance, implementation best practices, integrations, and platform optimization.

Location: Remote - United States

Key Responsibilities

Client Consulting & Solution Strategy

  • Serve as a recognized authority in Adobe Workfront solutions and technologies.
  • Gather and understand client business objectives, technical requirements, goals, and challenges.
  • Educate clients on Adobe Workfront best practices and industry-specific methodologies.
  • Evaluate solution designs and Workfront configurations to ensure implementation accuracy and alignment with recommended practices.
  • Analyze complex project challenges, identify solution options, and facilitate recommendation discussions with clients and partners.
  • Translate business requirements into architecture, design, and development activities utilizing Adobe Workfront solutions.

Workfront Architecture & Implementation

  • Lead and support enterprise Workfront implementations, including workflow design and platform configuration.
  • Provide guidance on project management methodologies including Waterfall, Scrum, Kanban, PMI, and hybrid approaches.
  • Validate implementation approaches and recommend scalable solutions aligned with client objectives.
  • Support data migration efforts from legacy tools and systems into Workfront.
  • Ensure adherence to governance standards and platform best practices.

Workfront Fusion & Integrations

  • Design, develop, and troubleshoot Workfront Fusion scenarios and automations.
  • Configure modules, develop functions, and implement integration workflows.
  • Utilize REST APIs, JSON structures, array refinement techniques, and error-handling best practices.
  • Integrate Workfront with enterprise systems including Creative Cloud, AEM Assets, Jira, Outlook, Salesforce, Slack, and other business applications.
  • Support ongoing optimization and troubleshooting of integration solutions.

Client Engagement & Delivery

  • Manage a high-volume portfolio of client engagements while ensuring timely execution and quality delivery.
  • Collaborate with marketers, analysts, developers, project teams, and business leaders.
  • Facilitate technical discussions with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Build credibility and trust through strong consulting, communication, and facilitation skills.
  • Act as an advocate for customer success and long-term platform adoption.

Documentation & Operational Excellence

  • Maintain accurate project records, workload estimates, and time tracking documentation.
  • Create client-facing documentation, presentations, and recommendations using Microsoft Office tools.
  • Continuously expand Adobe Workfront expertise through certifications, training, and self-study.
  • Stay current on Adobe Workfront product enhancements, features, and industry best practices.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Deep technical expertise in Adobe Workfront and Workfront Fusion.
  • Strong understanding of Workfront work management capabilities, including resource management, reporting, proofing, and document management features.
  • Experience implementing Adobe Workfront within enterprise environments.
  • Experience designing and configuring business workflows and project management processes.
  • Thorough knowledge of Workfront Fusion, including:
    • Module configuration
    • Function development
    • Scenario development
    • Troubleshooting
    • Governance best practices
  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON structures, array refinement, integration architecture, and error handling.
  • 5+ years of client-facing Workfront implementation and/or integration experience.
  • Experience integrating Workfront with solutions such as Creative Cloud, AEM Assets, Jira, Outlook, Salesforce, Slack, and similar enterprise platforms.
  • Proficiency in Java, PHP, or Python.
  • Experience with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Familiarity with relational databases and SQL.
  • Experience with data migration projects.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and implementation strategies.
  • Strong consulting, facilitation, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Adobe Workfront Core Developer Certification.
  • Adobe Workfront Fusion Developer Certification.
  • Experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
  • Experience with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Real-Time CDP (RTCDP), Adobe Analytics, or Adobe Target.
  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise marketing operations.
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Marketing Technology, or a related field.

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $135,000 – $185,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors.

About Blue Acorn iCi

Blue Acorn iCi, a business unit of Infosys Nova Holdings, LLC, is a digital experience partner helping global brands design, build, and optimize the future of customer engagement. We blend data, design, and technology to deliver connected commerce and content solutions that drive measurable results.

Specializing in the Adobe Experience Cloud, we provide end-to-end services across commerce, content, analytics, and customer insights. Backed by Infosys, we’re growing fast—and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

Our teams work at the intersection of strategy and execution—solving complex challenges for industry leaders in healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and beyond. From large-scale digital transformation programs to platform implementations and ongoing optimization, we bring deep expertise and a collaborative mindset to every engagement.

Why Join Us?

Blue Acorn iCi is a place for curious thinkers, smart builders, and digital pioneers. We’re more than a consultancy—we’re a team of innovators helping the world’s top brands shape the future of digital.

Here, you won’t just contribute to a project—you’ll drive meaningful outcomes, collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams, and grow your skills in a high-impact, high-growth environment. We believe great work starts with great people, and we’re committed to creating a culture where talent thrives, ideas spark change, and results speak for themselves.

If you’re ready to push boundaries, deliver real value, and help shape the next generation of digital experiences—this is your place.

Job Title: Senior Video Editor (Documentary & Short-Form Social Content)
Location: Remote
Role Type: Full-Time (60 hours/week, 6 days)
Working Hours: 4PM - 2AM (+8 GMT), Monday to Saturday

Who Are We?At Reef, we connect elite commercial talent with high-growth companies building world-class operational teams. We work exclusively with the top 3% of candidates and match you with established companies across Australia, New Zealand, the US, and UK who invest seriously in their business infrastructure.

We support your integration into these companies by providing you with additional training, admin/HR support, and adding you to our community of high-level professionals.

About the RoleWe're seeking an experienced Senior Video Editor to join a US-based media company producing conservative, news-focused content on immigration, border security, crime, and national security. This role focuses on cinematic long-form documentary content (10-45+ minutes) alongside short-form social clips cut from the same material for YouTube, X, TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook.

You'll work directly with producers on scripted, voiceover-driven narrative content, owning the edit from raw footage through to published asset across both formats. The production team provides scripts, sourced footage, and clear briefs; you bring the storytelling instinct and technical craft to turn that material into finished, emotionally engaging content.

What success looks like: Delivering every assigned edit on or before deadline within two revision rounds, maintaining a cinematic and journalistic tone across both long-form and short-form output, and producing content that holds viewer attention through strong narrative structure, pacing, and platform-specific optimisation. By month three, you'll be hitting 70%+ first-submission sign-off and anticipating recurring feedback before submission.

This role suits editors who take genuine pride in craft, have real documentary or narrative editing samples to show, and want the stability of a full-time seat rather than project-based work.

Requirements

  • Excellent spoken and written English with strong, proactive communication skills
  • 5+ years hands-on experience editing narrative, documentary, or long-form content
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve
  • Proven portfolio showcasing both long-form narrative work and short-form social clips
  • Strong instincts for pacing, hook structure, and emotional storytelling
  • Confident with audio mixing, colour correction, B-roll integration, sound design, and subtitle formatting
  • Understanding of platform-specific requirements (aspect ratios, opening seconds, caption styles) for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok
  • Ability to self-manage technical issues and file organisation via Google Drive or Dropbox
  • Availability for 60 hours per week, Monday to Saturday, with US daytime overlap
  • Responsiveness on Slack within 15-30 minutes during working hours
  • Fast and reliable internet connection; your own laptop or desktop suitable for the role; a quiet working environment; a good quality microphone or headset

Benefits

  • Compensation
    • $800-$1,200 USD per month, depending on experience and demonstrated output quality
    • Rate reviewed at 90 days based on deadline adherence, revision rates, brand consistency, and producer feedback
    • Top of band ($1,200) reserved for editors consistently delivering first-submission sign-off at 70%+ with zero missed deadlines
  • What's on Offer?
    • Direct engagement with an established US media company with a clear editorial voice
    • Craft-focused role with real ownership of the edit, not a support seat
    • Stable full-time income rather than project-based variability
    • Access to other job opportunities through the Reef network

Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by 1) providing the best services for homebuyers, 2) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance, 3) to protect the whole home.

As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title:Senior Manager, Business Operations

Location:United States 

Workplace Type:Remote 

 

Job Summary 

The future is bright for the Porch Group, andwe’dlove foryou to be a part of it as our Senior Manager, Business Operations.  

As Senior Manager, Business Operations, you will be a key leader responsible for the success and scaling of our Business Operations function. Reporting to the Head of Business Operations and Partnerships, you will sit at the intersection of high-level strategy and rigorous execution, equally comfortable developing a recommendation for leadership and rolling up your sleeves to make it happen. You will be expected to own outcomes, not just drive process.

Porch Consumer Services is a division of Porch that helps people navigate one of life's most complex transitions, moving and settling into a new home. We have built the platform that can serve them across the full journey, including the move, setting up and protecting their home, and everything in between. We enable millions of moves a year across our brands, including MovingPlace and HireAHelper. We’re building towards the one-stop-shop for the moving journey, powered by technology that makes every step smarter and easier.

You will define our strategic direction and shape how we prioritize across the division, developing the insights and frameworks that drive our annual planning and inform key tradeoffs. You will own end-to-end delivery of our most critical initiatives, from defining strategy through execution and performance monitoring.

As our division evolves, you'll play a key role in scaling operations across a broader consumer services portfolio, an opportunity to help shape how a growing organization structures itself for the next phase of growth.

What You Will Do As A Senior Manager, Business Operations:

Strategy & Initiative Execution

  • Own end-to-end delivery of strategic initiatives from definition through execution, including launching and scaling new products and services.

  • Develop strategies grounded in a deep understanding of business goals, constraints, and market dynamics, supported by rigorous quantitative and qualitative analysis.

  • Develop a deep understanding of our customers, providers, and partners to build a strong point of view on what matters in each initiative and use that to inform our strategy and how we prioritize.

  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, Finance, Legal and more, to align on priorities, remove blockers, and move with urgency.

Operating Cadence & Business Performance

  • Establish and run the operating rhythm of the division, including annual planning cycles, quarterly business reviews, and ongoing goal tracking.

  • Drive group-wide prioritization and tradeoff decisions, ensuring resources are focused on the highest-value opportunities.

  • Drive adoption of shared dashboards and reports, maintain visibility into initiative KPIs, and proactively surface insights with clear recommendations.

  • Support leadership team preparation for company and board-level reviews, ensuring the division presents with clarity and confidence.

  • Serve as a member of the Porch Consumer Services leadership team.

What You Will Bring As A Senior Manager, Business Operations:

  • 6-12 years of experience in strategy or business operations, preferably at a high-growth startup or technology company.

  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution with measurable results, including launching new products or service offerings.

  • Strong bias to action; comfortable operating with ambiguity, moving with urgency, and staying focused on outcomes over process.

  • Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to align stakeholders across diverse, cross-functional teams.

  • Experience building and running internal operating cadences, including business reviews, planning cycles, and performance reporting.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data and insights into actionable recommendations.

  • Comfort using AI tools as a genuine accelerator and core part of your work across research, analysis, automation, and communication.

This position's application window is anticipated to close in 2 weeks (10 business days) from 06/08/2026. Please know this may change based on business and interviewing needs.

At this time, Porch Group does not consider applicants from the following states or jurisdictions for Remote positions: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Mississippi, Nebraska, Montana, New Hampshire, West Virginia, or the District of Columbia.

WHAT YOU WILL GET AS A PORCH GROUP TEAM MEMBER

Pay Range*: $138,800 – $194,300 Annually

Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job-related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location.

Additionally, you will be eligible to receive long-term incentive awards, subject to program guidelines and approvals.

You will also be eligible to receive an annual bonus based on individual and company performance, subject to program guidelines and approvals.

Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial wellbeing.

• Our traditional healthcare benefits include three (3) Medical plan options, two (2) Dental plan options, and a Vision plan from which to choose.

• Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Accident plans are offered on a voluntary basis.

• We offer pre-tax savings options including a partially employer funded Health Savings Account and employee Flexible Savings Accounts including healthcare, dependent care, and transportation savings options.

• We provide company paid Basic Life and AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability benefits. We also offer Voluntary Life and AD&D plans.

• Both traditional and Roth 401(k) plans are available with a discretionary employer match.

• Supportlinc is part of our employer paid wellbeing program and provides employees and their families access to on demand guided meditation and mindfulness exercises, mental health coaching, clinical care and online access to confidential resources including will preparation.

• LifeBalance is a free resource to employees and their families for year-round discounts on things like gym memberships, travel, appliances, movies, pet insurance and more.

• Our wellness programs include flexible paid vacation, company-paid holidays of typically nine per year, paid sick time, paid parental leave, identity theft program, travel assistance, and fitness and other discounts programs.

What’s next?

Submit your application and our Porch Group Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! If your resume gets us intrigued, we will look to connect with you for a chat to learn more about your background, and then possibly invite you to have virtual interviews. What's important to call out is that we want to make sure not only that you're the right person for us, but also that we're the right next step for you, so come prepared with all the questions you have!

Porch is committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.

Porch is an Equal Opportunity employer. Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

As a Network Engineer, you will be responsible for providing 24/7 network support to clients across the globe in enterprise network operations and handling escalations and severe cases.

If this is you, and you wonder what it would be like to work at Pythian, reach out to us and find out!

Intrigued to see what a life is like at Pythian? Check out #pythianlife on LinkedIn and follow @loveyourdata on Instagram!

Not the right job for you? Check out what other great jobs Pythian has open around the world! Pythian Careers

What you will be doing:

This position is accountable for ensuring:

  • Administration and Management of complex networking solutions in enterprise data centers and remote offices worldwide.
  • Extensive experience with Cisco Catalyst and Nexus switches.
  • Advanced knowledge of ARP, MAC Address Table, VLAN, Spanning Tree Protocol, EtherChannel, Switch Stacking, HSRP/VRRP, Access Lists (ACLs), and NAT.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring and troubleshooting Enterprise LAN and WAN.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VPN technologies (IPSec, GRE), and routing/switching principles.
  • Hands-on experience in implementing security measures like access control lists (ACLs) and firewall policies to protect the network
  • Must have experience in enterprise network operations in handling escalation and severity cases.
  • Coordination with ISP, clients and onsite technical teams for troubleshooting network and security incidents.
  • Providing permanent remediation for affected endpoints in our network environment
  • Documenting network issues related to Incidents with in-depth event logs, RCA, and evidence
  • IOS/firmware upgrade in Cisco network devices as and when required
  • Good to have experience in configuring and troubleshooting CISCO wireless controllers, Aerohive Products.
  • Excellent client-facing communication skills and the ability to Manage client interactions and escalations, ensuring client satisfaction and timely resolution of critical issues.
  • Facilitate P2/P1 Technical calls from the network's end, demonstrating exceptional communication and problem-solving skills to de-escalate situations and provide clear, concise updates to clients.

What we need from you:

  • 5-10 years of experience implementing and managing multi-vendor network solutions.
  • Extensive experience in Routing and Switching.
  • Prior experience collaborating with global clients from the US, Europe, and APAC regions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to manage client expectations and handle high-pressure situations effectively.
  • Must be able to effectively handle multiple projects simultaneously
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on delivering effective solutions and efficiently managing client escalations. CCNA or CCNP Certifications are an asset.

What you will receive:

  • Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity.
  • Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
  • Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
  • Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!
  • Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!
  • Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favorite charity.

We are a venture-backed, tech startup seeking an exceptional Director of Loan Processing Operations to lead and scale our nationwide third-party mortgage processing team. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for someone who has personally run large, high-volume mortgage operations and knows exactly what an optimal processing workflow should look like from intake to funding.

The ideal candidate has deep experience from the ground up as a residential mortgage loan processor, has managed teams processing 1,000+ active loans in pipeline, and thrives in a fast-moving startup environment where operational excellence and structured processes must coexist with rapid innovation.

If this sounds like you and you also enjoy the flexibility and leadership opportunity that comes with working at a fully-remote tech startup, we would love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

Operational Leadership & Strategy

  • Design, build, and continuously optimize a high-volume, scalable loan processing operation handling hundreds to thousands of residential mortgage loans simultaneously.
  • Establish and enforce a team-based processing model, from loan registration to closing & funding.
  • Create the operational blueprint for how loans flow through our proprietary, AI-powered software platform, ensuring speed, quality, and regulatory compliance.

People Management

  • Recruit, train, lead, and mentor senior mortgage loan processors, junior support staff, and operations manager, and team leads.
  • Create workload allocation models to maximize processor throughput and ensure SLAs are consistently met.
  • Manage performance standards, coaching plans, and incentives tied to quality, speed, and customer satisfaction.

Process & Workflow Optimization

  • Develop and refine SOPs that minimize errors and reduce time to close.
  • Identify bottlenecks, root cause issues, and workflow gaps; implement corrective action quickly.
  • Provide feedback on workflow design, tasking systems, document handling, SLA automation, and supporting tools.

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure accurate, compliant disclosures and loan file documentation.
  • Maintain high standards of data integrity across LOS, lender portals, and internal systems.
  • Own quality control initiatives to reduce file errors and post-closing issues.

Client Experience

  • Maintain strong relationships with our clients, independent mortgage brokers.
  • Resolve client service issues, analyzing the root cause of issues, speaking to clients when an escalation is requested, and improving processes to prevent recurring problems.
  • Drive measurable improvements in turn times, processor responsiveness, borrower satisfaction, and client retention.

Required Experience & Qualifications

General Industry Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in residential mortgage loan processing and operations.
  • Previously worked full-time as a residential mortgage loan processor.
  • Managed large-scale processing operations with hundreds to thousands active loans in pipeline or equivalent high-volume responsibility.
  • Experience processing for independent mortgage brokers (not exclusively retail lenders or bank mortgage departments).
  • Proven success managing team-based processing structures (registration, disclosures, order outs, submissions, conditions, closing).
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable with: Google Workspace, Google Calendar, LOS systems, Calendly, video calls, Slack, email templates, screen sharing, etc.

Leadership Qualities

  • Highly organized, proactive, and operationally rigorous.
  • Strong people leader with the ability to coach, motivate, and elevate processing teams.
  • Excellent communicator; able to work cross-functionally with product, engineering, operations, and broker partners.
  • Startup-ready mindset: adaptable, resourceful, fast-moving, and positive under pressure.

About House Numbers. The U.S. mortgage industry originated 4.3 million loans in 2023, with $25 billion in origination labor costs. House Numbers is transforming inefficient, outdated processes in a slow-moving sector with an AI-powered mortgage loan processing service that delivers 50%+ cost savings, faster response times, and a shorter time to close, without requiring brokers or lenders to change their existing systems. Starting with independent brokers, our pay-per-loan pricing model allows us to scale profitably while still deeply undercutting the standard third party processing fees. We are backed by leading Silicon Valley venturecapital funds and angel investors, including Resolute Ventures, Maven Ventures, and Uncommon Capital.

Why Join Us?

  • 100% remote position work from anywhere in the U.S.
  • Flexible working hours, provided you can align with our clients time zones.
  • Equity ownership in the company.
  • PTO and room to shape your schedule.
  • Access to cutting-edge technology, automation tools, and streamlined systems.

Additional responsibilities include leading sales support activities such as quotes, sampling, and customer service; negotiating special pricing and conditions to improve profitability; and managing customer support to meet customer needs.

Qualifications include a bachelor’s degree in engineering or other technical discipline and 5 to 10 years’ experience in Sales, Engineering, or Business Development in a technical environment. A master’s degree is preferred. The ability to communicate in German, Italian, or Spanish is preferred.

Our client is the worlds leading producer of Niobium, a metal that belongs to the transition metals. When very pure, its soft, ductile, and highly resistant to corrosion. Niobium products are obtained from metallurgy processes and because it enhances properties and functionality, Niobium is used in a wide range of materials, such as alloy steel and oxides, and applications in sectors like mobility, energy, and construction. As the world transitions towards a greener future, role of Niobium-enhanced nanocrystalline magnetic materials in applications like batteries, inverters/converters, on-board chargers, and charging stations becomes indispensable in driving innovation towards a more sustainable and electrified world.

Niobium can contribute to the creation of more efficient and sustainable energy solutions, be it through the advancement of next-generation batteries, or the development of powerful nanocrystalline magnetic materials. Through its diverse roles in energy storage, conversion, and transfer, Niobium is assuming a pivotal role in advancing the generation of cleaner energy, bringing us closer to a carbon-neutral future.

Due to expansion, they are seeking a Head of Business Development to report to the New Materials & Applications Division Director and assume a key role in developing, growing and managing the sales & market development for the division, with the focus to develop niobium battery materials & specialty products market & ecosystem.

The Head of Business Development will define and implement the go to market strategy and business transformation initiatives with the goal of growing the revenue among actual customers and developing new customers. Also, will oversee implementing and leading the global business development team structure for the new materials & applications division.

We are seeking a talented, motivated, entrepreneur and top performer professional to join our team in this role with experience in commercial transformation and growth strategies in a B2B environment and top ranked strategic consulting firms


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

HEAD OF BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT NEW MATERIALS & APPLICATIONS EUROPE

Responsibilities:

  • Lead business transformation efforts to develop new potential
  • Engage with end users and ecosystems to develop additional leads for increase the niobium applied technology for battery materials & specialty products & applications
  • Manage & create new business opportunities for existing customer to maintain high degree of customer satisfaction and company´s business reputation and leadership
  • Develop & execute a strong bankable business plan to deliver the division Growth Plan to support the best commercial policy for niobium products in this market
  • Set the direction to the technical and market intelligence team with business drivers, assessing risk and exposure of the division and tracking and related upstream/downstream markets (Battery, Aerospace, medical, Energy, Optical, Electronic & Chemicals)
  • Support The Division Executive Director in other work streams as required
  • Lead Market analysis, Strategy and Commercial Transformation projects
  • Manage high performance and entrepreneur team

Core Competencies:

  • A hands-on leader with a desire to work in a dynamic, mission-driven environment
  • High-level of integrity and dependability with a strong sense of urgency and results-orientation
  • Proactive self-starter, entrepreneurial, with an 'owner's mindset'
  • Consistently delivers quality work on time, with a strong attention to detail
  • Strong analytical, negotiation and creative problem-solving skills
  • Exceptional oral communication, writing and editing skills
  • Motivated and optimistic
  • Demonstrated interest in deeptech, cleantech, electric vehicles or renewable energy a plus

Requirements:

  • University Degree in Business, Economics or Engineering preferred
  • 7-10 years of experience in business development and Commercial transformation projects in top Managed Consulting Firm or with Multiple Industries related to the new materials & Applications Division. Desirable having substantial experience and hands-on skills
  • Proven experience negotiating and closing supply agreements
  • Knowledge of environmental legislation trends and impacts for the energy storage market desirable
  • Excellent organizational, strategic, planning and implementing skills
  • Excellent presentation and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to assign and delegate work, problem solve, answer questions and evaluate results of performance
  • High level of critical and logical thinking, analysis, and/or reasoning to identify underlying principles, reasons, or facts
  • Ability to follow through and complete overlapping projects
  • Able to identify key issues; creatively and strategically overcome internal challenges or obstacles
  • Proven experience managing teams

Job Position:

  • Full time

Language Skills:

  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese would be beneficial but is not essential

raw.description:
Our client is a global leader in fire protection, specializing in both fire detection and suppression systems for commercial, industrial, and high-risk environments. The company's solutions are designed to protect life, property, and business continuity by combining early-warning detection with rapid, effective fire response.

On the detection side, they manufacture advanced smoke, heat, and multi-sensor detectors connected to intelligent control panels that provide real-time monitoring, alarms, and automated safety responses. This ensures fires are identified at the earliest possible stage, allowing prompt action to minimize damage.

For suppression, they offer versatile mechanical systems, including sprinklers, pumps and flow-switches. These are tailored to specific risks and integrate seamlessly with detection systems, ensuring coordinated and efficient fire mitigation.

Renowned for reliability, innovation, and compliance with international standards, they deliver complete, configurable fire safety solutions trusted by businesses worldwide, making it a global leader in comprehensive fire protection.

JOB PURPOSE

The Customer Service Manager (CSM) role is responsible for supervising & coordinating the daily activities of the Customer Service Representatives (CSRs) to ensure superior customer experience outcomes that differentiate the company from others in the Global Commercial Fire Notification and Fire Suppression marketplace.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

CUSTOMER SERVICE MANAGER - APAC

Key Accountabilities

1. Leading and motivating the customer service team to provide exceptional service to customers.

2. Training staff in customer service techniques and company policies

3. Resolving complex customer complaints or enquiries

4. Monitoring and analyzing performance metrics to ensure customer satisfaction

5. Maintaining a deep understanding of company products and services to provide accurate information to customers

6. Oversee the recruitment, training, development, and performance management of Customer Service Representatives, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.

  • Monitor Time Clock and approve CSRs hours worked.
  • Create, monitor, and maintain team schedule, including time off requests.
  • Fill in for CSRs as needed.
  • Maintains and communicates work procedures and policies to the team.
  • Observes and evaluates the performance of CSRs.
  • Coordinate the daily activities of the CSRs
  • Ensure that Customer Service Representatives are handling customer orders and
  • inquiries in a timely and courteous manner and in line with expected SLA for error-free order entry.
  • Ensure proper phone coverage and timely processing of all correspondence.

7. Coordinating with other departments to resolve issues impacting customer service.

8. Serve as the escalation point for complex customer orders and delivery schedule requests, working closely with relevant parties (Customer service, operations team members and at factories to resolve issues promptly and effectively.

9. Establish and maintain quality assurance processes and standards to ensure consistency and excellence in customer satisfaction.

10. Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance overall customer experience.

11. Makes recommendations to management concerning resource planning and improvement of process and procedures.

12. Reviews inventory reports & open order reports, research & expedites as needed.

13. Monitor the Customer Orders e-mail inbox, ensure Service Level Agreement (SLA) is being adhered to.

14. Handle additional requests/projects from management in a timely manner.

Required Qualifications

1. A minimum of 5 years of experience in customer service management.

2. Leadership and managerial skills with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop team members.

3. Ability to work outside non-standard work hours for meetings.

4. Strong software skills MS Office, Salesforce, and the company's proprietary developed software products.

5. Ability to act with integrity and professionalism.

6. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a customer-centric mindset.

7. Proven track record of driving results, meeting KPIs, and delivering high levels of customer satisfaction.

8. Knowledge of customer service best practices, quality assurance methodologies, and CRM systems.

9. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions.

10. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to changing business needs.

11. Working knowledge of MS Office Products (PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, and Word).

12. Fluent in both English and Chinese.

Flexible working arrangements, including home-based and hybrid options, are available to support work-life balance and accommodate individual needs.

On the suppression side, they offer a range of mechanical systems, including sprinklers, pumps, and flow-switches, all engineered to address specific risks and seamlessly integrate with detection systems for coordinated and efficient fire mitigation.

raw.title: BUSINESS VALUATION AND LITIGATION SUPPORT MANAGER
raw.excerpt: Our Client story began in 1982 when a group of seven people set out to create a better public accounting firm.
raw.description:
Our Client story began in 1982 when a group of seven people set out to create a better public accounting firm.

Their goal was to service their clients by acting as an advocate for their businesses, their families, and their employees. They also sought to avoid micromanaging the people who joined alongside them. Instead, they wanted their team to be able to come to work, flourish both professionally and creatively in their efforts, and lead their own lives.

Benefits:

  • Health Insurance-100% paid for employee-Blue Cross Blue Shield
  • Dental-Employee paid-about $20.00 per month
  • Vision care-Employee paid-about $7.00 per month
  • Life Insurance-Employer paid
  • Long Term Disability-Employer paid
  • Short Term Disability-Employee paid
  • 401-K with employer match
  • Cafeteria plan for additional tax savings on benefits

Misc:

  • Reimbursement for CPA study materials up to $2000
  • Bonus upon completion of CPA-$4000
  • PTO bank- up to 192 hours of leave annually
  • 10 holidays in addition to PTO
  • 2 weeks paid maternity/paternity leave
  • Flex start times
  • Dress for your day (casual dress code)
  • Work from home policy
  • All Continued education paid by employer
  • Latest technology and equipment for all positions
  • Annual Christmas bonus equal to one week of pay
  • Fun events and surprises throughout the year

Reports to: Partners

General

A manager should be involved in most of the areas for which partners are responsible. Managers should have complete knowledge of the firm's philosophy and policies and maintain expertise in the profession. A manager typically serves as a team leader. A manager is a liaison between the partner, client and staff. Managers may be partners-in-training or a permanent manager. Managers are responsible for the on-the-job training of the staff at all levels.

Essential Performance Functions

  • Supports the partners’ vision for the direction of the firm with their attitudes, words and actions.
  • Exhibits a positive attitude with workable solutions to complete projects. Uses appropriate judgment to determine when to seek further guidance
  • Accepts full responsibility for the completion of all work assigned..
  • Takes responsibility for the overall development of the team. Supports and encourages continuous learning. Identifies areas of weakness in team members and provides meaningful coaching to accelerate improvement. Identifies areas of strengths and helps maximize the value of those strengths within the firm. Mentors others in developing skills to build and sustain client relationships.
  • Gains respect from clients and peers for knowledge, quality of work, technical expertise and project management. Is viewed as an expert in the area of concentration. Seen by partners and clients as being able to handle the most complex issues.
  • Prepares necessary exhibits and memos in illustration of complex issues.
  • Prepares narrative reports in support of valuation analyses.
  • Consistently demonstrates team leadership while supervising multiple engagements or projects at the same time, ensuring that projects meet the time budget and targeted due dates. This requires the exercise of good judgment, the ability to delegate and monitor progress, plus give on-the-job training.
  • Builds strong relationships and enjoys a high level of credibility with the partners, managers and staff. Functions effectively in a team environment. Does what is best for the firm, not the individual.
  • Identifies ways to address client needs, managing introduction of technical experts or specialists where applicable.
  • Participates in firm administration, as needed and requested, in areas such as scheduling staff, giving performance evaluations, training, billing, recruiting and marketing.
  • Takes a leading role in business development. Interacts directly with clients and/or targets in marketing or business development events. Participates in the development of ways to meet client needs. Identifies opportunities for expanded services to existing clients. Actively participates in the leadership of professional, business and/or community organizations. Builds, maintains and utilizes network of client and non-client relationships. Managers should allocate at least 100 hours per year building and maintaining their network. Reinforces to staff that business development is encouraged and expected at all levels.
  • Productivity: Approximately 1,375 annual billable hours at acceptable realization levels.

Education, Experience and Skills required:

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • 5+ years of business valuation experience including financial reporting valuation and appraisal review
  • Holds a current and valid certified public accountant’s license.
  • CFA, ASA, ABV or other valuation industry credentials
  • Experience in litigation support matters including calculations of economic damage
  • Experience with testimony at trail and deposition
  • Proficiency with computer, spreadsheet software programs and calculator.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely

raw.title: Remote Python Developer
raw.excerpt: Our Python Developer will have the opportunity to build scalable systems and software for commercial and government use, by developing scalable solutions that leverage modern architecture and best practices, and enable significant processing at runtime.
raw.description:
Our Python Developer will have the opportunity to build scalable systems and software for commercial and government use, by developing scalable solutions that leverage modern architecture and best practices, and enable significant processing at runtime. You will provide technical expertise and support in the design, development, implementation, and testing.

You will also participate in and/or direct major deliverables of projects through all aspects of the software development lifecycle including scope and work estimation, architecture and design, coding for back-end, and unit testing. In addition, you would also work with our Data Science team to help operationalize the ML models for our v2 platform.

Your solutions should keep in mind scalability, with optimized usage of distributed computing using frameworks like Spark. You should also have strong familiarity and experience with how to leverage the AWS ecosystem to bring in relevant AWS tools, services, and resources to enable substantial processing of very large datasets before runtime, entity resolution between very large datasets, and real-time processing in a scalable, distributed computing environment.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development efforts to create platform v2
  • Participate in software programming initiatives to support innovation and enhancement, using Python and PySpark.
  • Leverage the AWS ecosystem to bring in relevant tools, services, and resources to enable distributed computing and scalable processing of very large datasets.
  • Problem solve and think creatively about the big picture and solution for our customers, proactively anticipate problems, and be customer-centric in our development and design, and be open-minded to different solutions for achieving a development milestone.
  • Clearly document processes, methodologies, and tools used.

Experience Required:

  • B.S. in relevant technical degree
  • Significant use and experience (at least 3-5 years) with Python, required
  • Significant experience (at least 3-5 years) with distributed computing and corresponding languages such as PySpark in the Spark ecosystem, required
  • Significant experience (at least 3-5 years) with the AWS ecosystem, including tools, services, and resources that enable scalable, distributed processing, required
  • Significant use and experience with writing complex SQL queries and analysis of data correlations, required
  • Experience utilizing software testing performance tools, such as Junit
  • Experience and knowledge of Git, AWS CodeCommit, or other such repos
  • Knowledge of ML fundamentals and acquaintance of popular ML libraries
  • Ability to work independently and integrate with other team members
  • Project management skills, ability to scope out timeline, methodology, and deliverables for development, testing, and integration into the platform
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Well-versed with using version control systems

The position is remote. The candidate must have the legal right to work in the United States.

Interview Process:

We will conduct 3 rounds of interviews.

  • First Round: Culture, fit, and background interview with the company Founders
  • Second Round: Technical Interview
  • Third Round: In-Person Day with Founders (We will have the candidate fly out to D.C. to meet the founders and team.)

Job Type: Full-time

Salary: $95,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off

Schedule:

  • Monday to Friday

Application Question(s):

  • Are you able to work full-time on a W2?
  • If selected, are you willing/able to fly to Washington, DC for an inperson interview (all travel expenses paid)?

Experience:

  • Python: 3 years (Required)
  • Distributed Programming: 2 years (Required)
  • AWS deployment: 2 years (Required)
  • Spark: 2 years (Required)
  • PySpark: 1 year (Required)
  • Apache Spark: 1 year (Preferred)

Finance Project Control Manager

Full Time Professional Remote, US Salary Range: $96,000.00 To $120,000.00 Annually

About the Role:

The Project Controls Manager Finance plays a critical role in ensuring the financial integrity and success of various projects within the organization. This position is responsible for developing and implementing project control systems that monitor project performance, manage budgets, and forecast financial outcomes. The manager will collaborate closely with project managers and stakeholders to provide insights and recommendations based on financial data analysis. By establishing effective reporting mechanisms, the Project Controls Manager will ensure that projects are delivered on time and within budget, ultimately contributing to the overall profitability of the company. This role requires a strategic mindset to align financial objectives with project goals, ensuring that resources are allocated efficiently and effectively.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in project controls or financial management within a project-based environment.
  • Proficiency in project management software and financial analysis tools.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Professional certification such as PMP (Project Management Professional) or PMI-SP (Scheduling Professional).
  • Experience in the management of large-scale projects in a corporate environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain project control systems to track financial performance and project progress.
  • Prepare and analyze project budgets, forecasts, and financial reports to provide insights to project teams.
  • Collaborate with project managers to identify financial risks and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure compliance with financial policies and procedures throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead regular project review meetings to discuss financial status and recommend corrective actions as needed.

Skills:

The required skills for this role include strong analytical abilities, which are essential for interpreting financial data and making informed decisions. Effective communication skills are necessary to convey complex financial information to non-financial stakeholders, ensuring everyone is aligned on project objectives. Proficiency in project management software allows the manager to efficiently track project progress and financial metrics. Leadership skills are crucial for guiding project teams and fostering a collaborative environment focused on achieving financial goals. Additionally, attention to detail is vital for maintaining accuracy in financial reporting and compliance with organizational policies
